title: Visual and Responsive Verification
description: Verify the updated heading size visually and ensure responsiveness across all supported screen sizes.
details: Start the local development server and open the landing page. Inspect the updated heading to confirm the font size reduction. Use browser developer tools to test the appearance on various devices (desktop, tablet, mobile). Ensure the heading remains legible and visually consistent with the rest of the design.
test_strategy: Manual visual inspection on multiple devices and screen sizes. Optionally, capture before/after screenshots for reference or team review.

title: Locate and Update Heading Font Size
description: Reduce the font size of the primary 'codespace' heading by modifying its Tailwind CSS utility class in the relevant component file.
details: Search for the heading with the text 'codespace' in the `app/page.tsx` file or any relevant component. Identify the HTML element (e.g., <h1>) and its current Tailwind CSS font size class (e.g., text-5xl). Change this class to a smaller size (e.g., text-3xl) according to the project's typography scale. Ensure the semantic tag remains appropriate for accessibility and SEO. If the heading is rendered via a shared component, override the class locally to avoid global side effects.
test_strategy: Manually verify in the browser that the heading is visibly smaller and maintains proper hierarchy. Check responsiveness on desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports. Confirm no layout or accessibility issues are introduced.
